intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Turul Games ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you play Hungry Cats: Triple Match (the "Game"), available on Google Play. By downloading or using the Game, you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Game.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
We do not ask you to create an account and we do not intentionally collect information that directly identifies you (such as your name or email address) unless you contact us by email.

When you first open the Game, an anonymous player account is created for you automatically. It is identified only by a random player ID, which you can see in the Game under Settings.

The Game and the third-party services it uses may collect:
- Game progress: your current level, coins, lives, skills, purchased items, and sound and vibration settings, linked to your anonymous player ID so your progress can be saved in the cloud.
- Device and technical information: device model, operating system version, language and region settings, and identifiers such as the app instance ID and the Android Advertising ID.
- Usage and gameplay data: levels played, level results, session length, features used, ads viewed, and similar analytics events.
- Purchase information: which in-game items you bought, the transaction ID, and the purchase receipt provided by Google Play. We never receive your payment card or bank details.
- Diagnostic data: crash logs, error reports, and performance data.

All of this information is collected in a pseudonymous form and is used to operate and improve the Game, not to identify you personally.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information
3. Cloud Save
sections.body:
Your game progress is stored on your device and also saved to Google Cloud Firestore, a Google Firebase service. The cloud copy is linked only to your anonymous player ID, not to your name, email, or Google account.

The Reset Game option in Settings restarts your level progress from Level 1. It does not delete your player data or your purchases. To have your data deleted, see section 11.

sections.heading: 4. In-App Purchases
sections.body:
The Game may offer optional in-app purchases, such as coins or other in-game items. Purchases are processed by Google Play. Your payment details are handled by Google under its own terms and privacy policy, and are never shared with us.

We receive only the information needed to confirm and deliver your purchase, such as the product purchased, the transaction ID, and the purchase receipt. We may verify receipts to prevent fraud.

Google Play Terms of Service: https://play.google.com/about/play-terms/

sections.heading: 5. Advertising
sections.body:
The Game may show advertisements provided through Google AdMob, including optional rewarded ads that give you an in-game reward for watching. AdMob and its advertising partners may use your device's Advertising ID and other data to serve and measure ads, including personalized ads where permitted.

Where required by law (for example in the EU/EEA and UK), we will ask for your consent before showing personalized ads. You can reset your Advertising ID or opt out of ad personalization at any time in your device settings under Settings > Google > Ads (or Settings > Privacy > Ads, depending on your device).

For more information about how Google uses data from AdMob, see https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites and https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6128543

sections.heading: 6. Analytics and Crash Reporting
sections.body:
We use third-party analytics and crash-reporting tools to understand Game usage and stability. These tools include Google Analytics for Firebase and Firebase Crashlytics (Google), and Unity analytics and diagnostics services (Unity Technologies). They collect data such as device information, usage events, and crash logs on our behalf.
- Google / Firebase Privacy Policy: https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
- Unity Privacy Policy: https://unity.com/legal/privacy-policy

sections.heading: 7. Third-Party Services
sections.body:
The Game relies on the following third-party services, each governed by its own privacy policy:
- Google Firebase (anonymous sign-in, cloud save, analytics, and crash reporting) - https://firebase.google.com/support/privacy
- Google AdMob (advertising) - https://policies.google.com/privacy
- Google Play Billing (in-app purchases) - https://policies.google.com/privacy
- Unity Technologies (game engine, in-app purchase integration, analytics, diagnostics) - https://unity.com/legal/privacy-policy
- Google Play Services - https://policies.google.com/privacy

sections.heading: 8. Sharing of Information
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. Information is shared only with the third-party service providers listed above so they can perform their functions (cloud save, purchases, advertising, analytics, crash reporting), and where required by law or to protect our legal rights.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.body: The Game is intended for a general audience and is not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the minimum age required in your country). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us at turulgames0@gmail.com and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 10. Data Retention and Security
sections.body: In-game progress is stored locally on your device and in the cloud for as long as you use the Game, or until you ask us to delete it. Purchase records may be kept as long as needed to deliver and restore your purchases and to meet legal and accounting obligations. Data processed by our third-party providers is retained according to their own retention policies. We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information, but no method of transmission or storage over the internet is 100% secure.

sections.heading: 11. Your Rights and Data Deletion
sections.body:
Depending on where you live, you may have rights under laws such as the GDPR (EU/EEA/UK), the CCPA/CPRA (California), or KVKK (Turkey), including the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, and the right to object to processing.

To exercise these rights or to have your cloud save deleted, email us at turulgames0@gmail.com and include your player ID (shown in the Game under Settings), so we can find your data. Deleting your data also removes your in-game progress and purchased items from the cloud, and they cannot be restored. Uninstalling the Game removes the progress stored on your device.

You can also control ad personalization and reset your Advertising ID through your device settings.

sections.heading: 12. International Data Transfers
sections.body: Our third-party providers may process and store data on servers located outside your country of residence, including in the United States. Where required, these providers rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.heading: 13. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make significant changes, we will update the "Last updated" date and, where appropriate, provide a notice inside the Game. The current version is always available at this page.

sections.heading: 14. Contact Us
sections.body:
